robotsAssessment: robots.txt for www.ema.europa.eu disallows /core/, /profiles/, /admin/, /search/, /user/* and /media/oembed. It disallows no path under /en/documents/report/ or /en/medicines/, and explicitly allows /*/documents/report/*.json$. The two paths retrieved here, /en/documents/report/medicines-output-medicines-report_en.xlsx and /en/medicines/download-medicine-data, are permitted.
